title: Cabela Mayhem
description: A mod that adds creatures to unlock and collect.
body:

# About
This mod adds weird creatures, called cabelas, to your minecraft world. You can collect these creatures and discover their variants to get all the trophies. Feed them with the new Frango crop to get them to breed. This mod currently doesn't contain much, but will be incremented over the next versions.

# Updates
### Initial release
1.0.0
1. Regular cabela variant, spawns in meadows, stony peaks, and old growth biomes
2. "Cry" variant, bred from very hurt parents
2. New frango crop
3. Trophies for each variant
4. Head blocks for each variant

# Coming "soon"
- More variants, such as the golden cabela
- Advancements
- New drops
